title: Excavation behind the street setback line may extend to the lot boundary
text: Excavation within the site is permitted behind the street setback line and may be constructed up to the lot boundary. Note: NCC and engineering requirements may apply.

replaces.note: Part B: fill/excavation within 1 m of a boundary limited to 0.5 m

notes: from: ch3 C3.5.3 (unchanged). Permissive clause encoded as a yes/no: all excavation on the site lies behind the street setback line (excavation forward of the line is C3.5.1); true where no excavation is proposed. Relevant to semi-basement car parks. NCC and engineering requirements may apply.

verified.note: Permissive clause; page clear. Yes/no encoding is an interpretation (see notes).
